svg.text: Per process
lives until exit
IR built by to_ir, keyed by the step object and its parent path (dropped with the step)
compiled step dispatchers and kernels, keyed by content fingerprint
params bundle classes, one per tuple of field names (bundle_class)
Per Executable
built by Engine.bind
the Plan from resolve(ir), with call and version ids
NodeParams per call: pydantic model, bundle class, bundle of defaults
the runner's Compiled snapshot (units, packed kernels, fallbacks), made on first iterate
Per params document
keyed by a sha256 of its JSON
the document key, hashed once while the same object is passed again
a Validation per (document key, node path): status, bundle, errors, warnings
the namespace check, and converted bundles with str params as UTF-8 spans
Per call
run or session
a State: an array and validity mask per NodeVersion, plus the frame
a RunParams over the document, and its RunReport (thread-local on the Executable)
the runner's generator of Checkpoints, drained by run, stepped by a Session
